https://mastodon.social/@cuirass_enterta.text: For those who never used this system, it was unique. It was a #linux system with low specs and a front end store where users could buy and play their games. It was an excellent place to cut my teeth with indie development because it had passionate players and a supportive community. I am not kidding when I say End's Reach would not have existed without those people. Ironically, we need low spec indie friendly platforms more than ever now with the rising costs of #gaming hardware. Oh well!
